statements.statement: The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient reports recent episodes of transient neurological deficits suggestive of a transient ischemic attack (G45.9)
A 48-hour Holter monitor study (CPT 93226) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits regulations indicating care may be covered by another payer
A 48-hour Holter monitor is medically necessary for continuous rhythm assessment to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
